exclusions.source_text: Patient must have a performance status of ≤1 on the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Scale.
Known cases of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) are excluded if patients have a CD4+ T-cell (CD4+) count \<250 cells/uL.

Known history of a hematologic malignancy (or solid tumor other than the ones indicated for this study), unless the patient has undergone potentially curative therapy with no evidence of that disease for 2 years.
exclusions.threshold: no evidence of disease for 2 years
